simple.meaning: חֶרֶב (chereb) is a Hebrew object word meaning “drought ; also a cutting instrument (from its destructive effect), as a knife , sword , or other sharp implement.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 3:24. The surrounding context includes family, family line, death, city.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חֶרֶב (H2719) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
